name: Ithran
overview: Ithran is a male Edomite figure known primarily as the son of Dishon, situating him within the Edomite tribal lineage. The biblical record provides minimal additional detail about his life or role beyond his genealogy.
namesAndTitles: The name Ithran means 'what is over, profit; excellent,' reflecting positive attributes in its Hebrew meaning. This proper name was not given by God but is recorded in Genesis 36:26.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly identifies Ithran as the son of Dishon, establishing his place within the Edomite family line. No other familial relationships are recorded in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Ithran's significance lies chiefly in his genealogical placement within the Edomite people, as recorded in Genesis 36:26. His mention contributes to the biblical account of Edomite ancestry, which is important for understanding the broader narrative of the descendants of Esau. Although the text does not elaborate on his personal deeds, his inclusion underscores the detailed preservation of Edomite lineage in Scripture.
